items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal effects (4.3(d)) and were in a conveyance away from the insured location (4.3(f), 4.5). Not indemnified.
Conveyance-related expenditure is excluded (4.3(e), 5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)) and there is no insured event. Not indemnified.
